id.description: Unique identifier of this equipment category.

name.description: Display name of the equipment category, unique within the company.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this equipment category.

is_active.description: Whether this category is currently active. Inactive categories are hidden from selection lists but retained for historical records.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this category.

login.description: Email address (login) of the user who created this category.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this category.
Display name for the equipment category. Must be unique within the company.
